LanguageData.MooGirl_Nuzzled.stages.0.label: Being Snuggled
LanguageData.MooGirl_Nuzzled.stages.0.description: The Mugirl gently nestles against you with her soft fur, warm and adorable. She whispers that everything will be alright, making you feel the current difficulties aren't so overwhelming anymore.
LanguageData.MooGirl_Nuzzled.stages.1.label: Being Affectionate
LanguageData.MooGirl_Nuzzled.stages.1.description: The Mugirl lightly nuzzles against you, comforting you with her own experiences as if to say: even when facing hardships, there will always be someone by your side. You feel warmth in your heart and the pressure eases considerably.
LanguageData.MooGirl_Roped.stages.0.label: Being Roped Along
LanguageData.MooGirl_Roped.stages.0.description: Waaah~ I'm a Mugirl, not a muffalo! Please stop leading me around on a rope~ (T_T)
LanguageData.MooGirl_Roper.stages.0.label: Roped a Mugirl
LanguageData.MooGirl_Roper.stages.0.description: Hehe, leading this cute Mugirl around is a little mean-spirited, but it really is kind of fun~
LanguageData.MooGirl_Roper.stages.1.label: Roped a Lot of Mugirls
LanguageData.MooGirl_Roper.stages.1.description: Wow! I've got so many cute Mugirls on ropes. It's a little perverse, but I feel almost like a king! Hehe~
